name: Dashboard Layout
description: One person's saved arrangement of a dashboard page: which sections and dimensions it shows, and in what order. A preference, not a record of the business: it changes what a page draws for its owner and grants nothing.

fields.label: Page
fields.description: The dashboard page's route, without the leading slash (reports, governance-gaps, emerging-risks).

fields.label: Layout
fields.description: The sections in order, each with whether it is shown and its dimensions in order. Empty means the page's own default.

fields.label: Customised
fields.description: Cleared by Reset to default; the row is kept so a later save reuses it.

provenance: REQUIREMENTS-COVERAGE O-3 (class d): per-user dashboard customisation
